# Photographs {#sec-photographs}

Photographs are items of type *photograph* (Q17).

```{python}
#| label: setup
from baldessari import cps, plots, table, works_table
photos = cps.photographs()
```

The CPS Wikibase contains **`{python} len(photos)`** photographs.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-photographs
#| tbl-cap: "Photographs in the CPS Wikibase."
table(works_table(photos))
```

## Works per period

```{python}
#| label: fig-photos-per-year
#| fig-cap: "Photographs by year of creation (five-year bins)."
plots.per_year(photos)
```
